corpus.title: AI Job-Hunt Copilot
corpus.content:
Built a production RAG pipeline in Python using ChromaDB for vector storage and Gemini text-embedding-004 for embeddings. Implemented MMR re-ranking to remove near-duplicate evidence and a deterministic grounding critic that rejects any generated resume bullet citing no retrieved chunk.

Orchestrated a multi-step agent workflow with LangGraph state machines: job-description parsing, requirement-level retrieval, match analysis, drafting, and self-correction. Served the pipeline through a FastAPI application with structured logging and rate limiting.

corpus.title: Infonix Cloud
corpus.content:
Co-founded a software company delivering production web and mobile applications to 60+ business clients using React.js, Node.js, Laravel, and Flutter.

Designed and deployed AI chatbots and automation agents that handle customer support, lead qualification, and follow-up workflows. Built custom ERP and CRM platforms backed by MySQL and MongoDB with role-based access control.

corpus.title: Gemini Pro Chat Application
corpus.content: Developed a real-time LLM chat application with Streamlit and the Google Gemini API, featuring streaming responses, persistent session history, and Markdown rendering. Implemented secure API key handling, session state management, and retry-based error handling in Python.

corpus.title: PGT Global Network Internship
corpus.content: Built a full-stack web portal using React.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Supabase with authentication. Developed REST APIs, relational data models, and reusable modular components for profiles, blogs, and user activity feeds.

corpus.title: Finance Tracker App
corpus.content: Developed a full-stack finance tracker with React, Node.js, and Supabase. Built dynamic dashboards using Recharts for income, expense, and category analysis, with Context API and custom hooks for scalable state management.

corpus.title: Classplus Internship
corpus.content: Led on-ground execution of a national techpreneurship competition across 150+ schools, coordinating with principals and running technical interviews at the national round.

job_descriptions.name: ai_ml_engineer
job_descriptions.text: We are hiring an AI/ML Engineer to build retrieval-augmented generation systems in production. You will design agentic pipelines, own retrieval quality and evaluation, and ship LLM-powered features to real users. Required: strong Python, RAG architectures, vector databases, API design with FastAPI. Preferred: LangGraph or similar orchestration frameworks, PyTorch, and experience with evaluation harnesses.

job_descriptions.name: full_stack_engineer
job_descriptions.text: Looking for a Full-Stack Engineer to build customer-facing web applications. You will own features end to end across a React and TypeScript frontend and a Node.js backend, working with relational databases and REST APIs. Required: React, TypeScript, Node.js, SQL. Preferred: experience shipping products to production clients and integrating third-party APIs.
